hypothesis: Replacing C55's pooled auxiliary heads with a structured FACT causal-token port will test token/mask/loss/data contracts before the full layer-wise H3-to-action backbone port C56b.
single_variable: Relative to D0-H32-s14000, C56a appends one zero-initialized causal token module with clean-action-conditioned future-state, value and future-H3 flow tracks; it is a mechanical precursor and not the full FACT backbone replacement.

references.title: FACT: Failure-Aware Causal Training for World-Action Models
H3-WAM C56a structured FACT causal-token port

architecture.paper: act then imagine: predicted action cannot see future; clean action conditions future
architecture.local: [state/text|H3-ref|pred_action|clean_action|future_state|value|future-H3-representation] with the same segment visibility matrix
architecture.rationale: The test extracts the pinned official function by AST and proves the local additive mask is tensor-identical; future H3 representation occupies FACT's future-image visibility segment.

architecture.paper: one trainable Wan causal diffusion transformer
architecture.upstream_code: Wan patch tokens and robot tokens share every transformer block
architecture.local: Frozen INT8 H3 K/V ref tokens and the trainable five-block D0 ActionDiT stem feed a separate five-layer nn.TransformerEncoder with a zero-initialized action residual
architecture.rationale: C56a validates FACT token order, masking, objectives and gradient plumbing, but it appends a causal trunk instead of inserting P/A/G/V/I adapters into every layer of the H3-to-action tower. It is forbidden to claim full FACT equivalence or enter long training; C56b must reuse the C58b 30-layer infrastructure and remove this separate trunk.

architecture.paper: first denoise action, then condition future/value on that clean action
architecture.upstream_code: Stage 1 [state|ref|pred_action], Stage 2 preserves dummy pred-action then adds clean action/future tracks
architecture.local: forward_action and forward_consequence expose the same two stages and preserve a dummy predicted-action track in Stage 2
architecture.rationale: The public two-stage interface and causal inputs match FACT, but computation runs through C56a's appended trunk rather than the official shared per-layer video/action blocks.

data.field: dense rollout windows and failure metadata
data.paper: demonstrations plus failed rollouts with causal failure onset
data.local: C48 provides 21559 replan-dense rows over 560 episodes; C59 provides episode failure mask and explicit onset contract without copying tensors
evidence: C59: 560 episodes, 362 failures, 0 annotated onsets, 21559 samples
data.rationale: LIBERO replan8 state coverage replaces RoboTwin per-frame data. No causal onset is fabricated: all failure actions are masked, observed futures and base temporal values remain supervised, and the +1 penalty stays inactive until an explicit onset exists.

data.paper: Eq.6 increasing progress minus failure penalty
data.upstream_code: remaining-time plus positive failure penalty, normalized from [0,2] to [-1,1]
data.local: loader requires an explicit enum and the first executable arm uses pinned-code remaining-time plus penalty; paper Eq.6 is retained as a separate non-default target
data.rationale: Executable-code reproduction takes precedence. The loader rejects an inactive failure value above 1.0, preventing the old C48 all-failure +1 convention from re-entering training.

data.paper: failure penalty begins at the causal failure onset
data.upstream_code: failure_active_from_frame activates the code-value +1 penalty while the whole failed episode masks action imitation
data.local: C60 has 83 exact-state counterfactual branches whose changed first action is the explicit onset: train 51 episodes/1929 rows/17 parent sources and validation 32/1186/11, parent-source disjoint
data.rationale: The intervention onset is causally known even though it is not claimed to be a visually irreversible event; C60 is the penalty-active stream, while C59 unannotated failures retain penalty=0.

action.field: action semantics, horizon and failure imitation mask
action.paper: RobotTwin delta actions; failed rollout actions are not imitated
action.upstream_code: 48 actions, failure_episode sets action_loss_mask=0 for every episode row
action.local: 32-step LIBERO D0 normalized action chunks with exact gripper round trip; C59 sets action_loss_mask=0 over the entire failed episode
action.rationale: The D0 action and deployment contract must remain fixed for attribution; only FACT's failure imitation mask is added.

objective.field: joint flow tracks and relative weights
objective.paper: joint denoising of action, future, state and value
objective.upstream_code: flow targets noise-clean with action:visual:future-state:value weights 10:1:0.4:0.4
objective.local: flow targets for action, future-H3 representation, future state and value with exact relative weights 10:1:0.4:0.4
objective.rationale: Future H3 flow replaces pixel-latent flow while preserving noisy token inputs, velocity targets, causal placement and loss scale.

objective.paper: future objectives shape the shared action backbone but future targets cannot be observed by predicted action
objective.local: future-only backward reaches clean-action D0 blocks and the shared causal trunk; predicted-action input gradient is zero and action output is invariant to all future/clean tracks
objective.rationale: This directly proves the C56a no-leakage and D0 clean-action gradient paths, but it does not prove the full FACT property that every predicted-action and future token traverses the same video-backbone blocks.

optimization.upstream_code: 8 GPUs, batch32/GPU, 150000 steps, base LR2e-5/action LR2e-4, warmup cosine
optimization.local: eight A800 ranks, eight immutable success rows, one independent AdamW step/rank at 2e-5, five appended causal layers; checkpoints retained only for restore audit
optimization.rationale: This allocation validates a real 8-GPU batch and measures total initialization-plus-one-step memory/time only; the 77.9-second wall time is not a steady-state training throughput estimate and cannot produce a promoted checkpoint.

evaluation.paper: RoboTwin success and optional best-of-N value ranking
evaluation.upstream_code: two-stage pipeline produces action/future/value; RoboTwin interface evaluates policy
evaluation.local: after a real mechanical probe, freeze a matched action-only D0 continuation and compare fixed balanced-80 conditioning first; fresh LIBERO tri-arm rollout is required for any promotion
evaluation.rationale: LIBERO is the project benchmark. No mechanical or offline consequence metric can substitute for fresh success rate.

evidence: Local official FACT 618a6c1 is clean; fetched upstream 9427ea4 differs only by three README lines (live demo).

Nine focused C56a unit tests pass, including official-mask AST parity, two-stage causal invariance and exact D0 step0 preservation; this gate covers the structured port only, not full backbone equivalence.

Future-only backward: nonzero clean-action input, D0 block and causal-backbone gradients; zero predicted-action input gradient.
C56a appends nn.TransformerEncoder after the five-block D0 carrier; FACT shares video/action/future tokens inside every backbone block. C56b is required before any long run.
Local CPU synthetic one-step report: PASS_C56_MECHANICAL_PROBE, all losses/gradients finite.
Eight-rank real strict state restore reproduces action/future-state/value/future-representation with max_abs=0: /mnt/h3-wam/outputs/c56-fact-backbone-port-v1/mechanical-probe-8gpu-v1/AGGREGATE.json.
C56a real H3/D0 mechanical probe passed 8/8 ranks, but no episode-disjoint paired training ran and the appended-trunk architecture is explicitly not eligible for long training.
No C56 checkpoint has been evaluated in fresh LIBERO rollout.

decision.rationale: The completed C56a canary validates source, token mask, data labels, gradients, 8-GPU finite execution and strict restore only. The separate causal trunk is a documented architecture deviation, so C56a is NO_GO for long training; C56b must implement the layer-wise shared H3-to-action backbone first.
